definitions.explanation: A distinguishing feature or object used as a reference point to identify a location or thing. Used both for physical markers and visual cues for navigation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{目印|めじるし}です。
examples.english: The red roof is the landmark.

examples.japanese: ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦リボン→リボン：11256_ribon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}けて→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧{目印|めじるし}にした。
examples.english: I tied a ribbon on my luggage as a mark to identify it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{時計台|とけいだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{目印|めじるし}にして⟦{歩|ある}いて→歩く：00538_aruku⟧きて⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please walk toward the big clock tower in front of the station as your landmark.

notes:
USAGE:
{目印|めじるし} is used when giving directions ("look for X as a landmark") or when marking something for later identification. It is a very common everyday word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {目印|めじるし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to use as a landmark/marker)
- {目印|めじるし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to serve as a landmark)
- {目印|めじるし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧ (to put a mark on something)
- ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{目印|めじるし} (a good landmark)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧ means "goal" or "target," not a visual marker. ⟦{標識|ひょうしき}→標識：15865_hyoushiki⟧ refers to an official sign (like a road sign), while {目印|めじるし} is any distinguishing feature used as a reference point.
